title: Continuity of the frame projection on linearly independent frames (Step 1.5(b))
statement: For all N, n ∈ ℕ, consider the map v ↦ frameProjection v = (span{v_1, …, v_n}).starProjection from (ℝ^N)ⁿ = (Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), with the product topology, to the space of continuous linear maps ℝ^N → ℝ^N with the operator-norm topology. This map is continuous on the set of linearly independent frames (ContinuousOn).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ), ContinuousOn (fun v : Fin n → Rn N ↦ frameProjection v) {v | LinearIndependent ℝ v}
